target.statement: OCRKM achieves 86.15% accuracy on the acute_inflammation dataset (Table 1, row acute_inflammation, column OCRKM).

compute.basis: The method solves a small linear system (kernel matrix inversion) for a tiny UCI dataset; hyperparameter grid search over 11x11 values with 5-fold CV is the main cost, but still minutes on a CPU.

blockers: Code repository may be incomplete or outdated; need to verify it contains the exact OCRKM implementation and data splits.
Exact train/test split and random seed not specified, so reproducing the exact 86.15% may require multiple runs or may not match exactly.
